entities.summary: Chiang Chih-hsien is a Taiwanese professional baseball third baseman who is a free agent. He has previously played in the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL) for the Brother Elephants/Chinatrust Brother Elephants and Fubon Guardians.
